payload.body: Unblocked: the user gated this behind the Rust migration, which is now complete (cutover landed on PR #8). Re-evaluate against the current code — the original race (subscribeObject resolving before server-side registration) is in the client runtime (packages/core, kept) and/or the protocol, so it likely survives the cutover; confirm whether it still reproduces against the Rust server before fixing. Not part of the this-session bug fixes (it was pre-existing, not found during the rewrite).
